race.comment: FIORENTE RULES (7) made a little late ground without posing a threat last start over 1400m at Morphettville Parks. Back in grade today and strips fitter at the third run back from a spell. Well in after the claim so plenty to like about her prospects. SHALHAVMUSIK (12) hasn't won for a while but put the writing on the wall last start when an eye-catching second over this course and distance. Faces a tricky draw but otherwise looks ideally placed to go one better. TAUPO TIGER (1) made it two wins from his last four runs when he got up in the dying stages of a BM56 over this track and trip 12 days ago. Getting up in the weights but he has never raced better and must be included in calculations. TRACK PATCHER (3) found 1050m far too slick when resuming at Morphettville recently. In the right race to improve sharply. DODD (11) found the line well first-up at Strathalbyn. Can keep the ball rolling in this suitable second-up assignment.
